rbi.title: RBI Monetary Policy Brief
rbi.desc: Alters benchmark repo rate from 6.50% to 8.50% and standing deposit facility from 6.25% to 8.25%.
rbi.source: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee decided by a 4 to 2 majority to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50 percent in its August 2024 meeting. Consequently, the standing deposit facility rate remains at 6.25 percent and the marginal standing facility rate at 6.75 percent. The MPC reiterated its commitment to withdraw accommodation to achieve 4% headline inflation.
